"Behind the Sun" is a song by the Red Hot Chili Peppers from their 1987 album, The Uplift Mofo Party Plan.
It was not released as a single until 1992 when it was used to promote the band's What Hits!?
The song charted at number 7 on the US Billboard Modern Rock Tracks chart and in New Zealand, as well as number 37 on the Australian ARIA Singles Chart.
